description: A script to generate and manage bundled provider authentication environment variables. It imports utility modules, processes provider auth env vars from plugin sources, and outputs a TypeScript module with the environment variable candidates.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes providerAuthEnvVars object into a sorted array of providerId and envVars pairs.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects provider authentication environment variables from bundled plugin sources and returns a sorted object.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript module string from provider environment variables entries.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Writes the generated environment variables module to disk, using utilities to handle output.
